select cd.month_label as month,
       count(*) as orders_delivered,
       round(avg(dd.delivery_days)::numeric, 1) as avg_delivery_days,
       round(cast(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by dd.delivery_days) as numeric), 1) as median_delivery_days,
       round(cast(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by dd.delivery_days) as numeric), 1) as p90_delivery_days,
       round(100.0 * sum(case when dd.delivery_days <= 5 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 1) as pct_within_5_days
from (
  select o.id as order_id,
         o.placed_at,
         (cast(
            (select max(s.delivered_at)
             from fulfillments f
             join shipments s on s.fulfillment_id = f.id
             where f.order_id = o.id) as date)
          - cast(o.placed_at as date)) as delivery_days
  from orders o
  where o.status = 'fulfilled'
    and o.placed_at >= timestamp '2024-01-01'
    and o.placed_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
    and exists (
      select 1 from fulfillments f join shipments s on s.fulfillment_id = f.id where f.order_id = o.id
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1 from fulfillments f join shipments s on s.fulfillment_id = f.id where f.order_id = o.id and s.delivered_at is null
    )
) dd
join calendar_days cd on cd.calendar_date = cast(dd.placed_at as date)
group by cd.month_label
order by cd.month_label
note: Delivery days are computed as calendar-day difference between placed_at and the latest shipment delivered_at across all shipments for the order (requiring all linked shipments to be delivered); orders with no shipments are excluded as specified. Month grain uses calendar_days.month_label on the order's placed_at date.
